reference: Frozen original GGUF parser/writer/splitter and llama C APIs on x64 MSVC and x64 GNU.
independence: All model/index/format outputs were captured before any Rust model evaluation. Only lossless extraction, exact duplicate removal and f32 little-endian serialization occur in packaging. Expected data never comes from Rust.
tolerance_origin: Existing inference portability budget, selected in this packer before the first Rust shard evaluation. It does not replace the original architecture-specific fixtures or their stricter gates. Token IDs, byte payloads and structural decisions remain exact.
qualifications: The original subsidiary split.no wrong-type getter aborts; the Rust API returns a checked error instead. Native exit codes are retained.
Native raw GGUF inspection with no_alloc can parse a truncated payload; the model loader rejects it. The Rust reader performs the model payload-bounds validation at parse time.
Primary metadata alone controls the model. Subsidiary metadata is not merged; only split.no is required and checked.
The source zero-tensor writer pads, while its reader reports the unpadded header position.
Synthetic model data validates execution and loader integration; it is not pretrained-model coverage.
The existing Rust parser strict UTF-8/NUL-key boundary, ordered streaming split/merge writer and external checkpoint conversion are not closed by this shard slice.
